items.statement: Each reported complex candidate is explicitly identified and the advanced geometry is checked as a stationary minimum or transparently marked as a bounded failure.
items.expected: Per-system candidate identity, structure, provenance, and minimum/stationarity evidence are present.

items.statement: The fundamental O-H observable is computed with an explicitly described anharmonic treatment and numerical/model validation.
items.expected: The report distinguishes the fundamental from the overtone and records model coordinate, convergence, units, and an independent validation check.

items.statement: The submission reports frequency and oscillator strength for each named complex, retaining candidate identity.
items.expected: Five named systems have complete or explicitly justified bounded-failure records with the two requested observables when available.

items.statement: The conclusion tests methyl-count and positional-isomer effects on the O-H response and separates vibrational trends from binding or equilibrium claims.
items.expected: A supported trend interpretation is given with scope and limitations.
